name: Trade Party Query Criteria 7
definition: Details on the queried trade parties.

Operator.name: Operator
Operator.definition: Specifies the AND/OR operators as query criteria.

ReportingCounterparty.name: Reporting Counterparty
ReportingCounterparty.definition: Identifies the reporting counterparty of the contract.

OtherCounterparty.name: Other Counterparty
OtherCounterparty.definition: Identifies the other counterparty of the contract.

Beneficiary.name: Beneficiary
Beneficiary.definition: Identifies the party subject to the rights and obligations arising from the contract.

EntityResponsibleForReport.name: Entity Responsible For Report
EntityResponsibleForReport.definition: Identification of the entity in the case where a financial counterparty is responsible for reporting on behalf of the other counterparty.

SubmittingAgent.name: Submitting Agent
SubmittingAgent.definition: Identifies the submitting agent of the reported of the contract.

Broker.name: Broker
Broker.definition: Identifies the broker who acts as an intermediary for the reporting counterparty.

CCP.name: CCP
CCP.definition: Unique code for the CCP that has cleared the contract.

ClearingMember.name: Clearing Member
ClearingMember.definition: Identifies the clearing member through which a derivative transaction is cleared at a central counterparty (CCP).  The element applies to transactions under the agency clearing model and the principal clearing model.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
